text: Comms spacetime map: 'ship · now' label overlaps another label ('...es') at the 10 rs row on retry
Objective 'Wait for Ines's reply' stayed open ~15 game s after her reply 'Engine's lit! ... I'm coming home!' arrived (tick 7995); completed only at tick 8901 after the 'Twenty minutes later' card
Objective 'Return to 10 rs (helm)' still shown open at tick 12429 although ship reached 10 rs and WREN said 'Back at station' at tick 12051 (>6 game s, ~1 min real)

Spacetime map console after rescue (Ines's fall): the 'Ines' label sits on top of the green 'Engine burn: climbing out' label, so it reads 'Ines e burn: climbing out'; same overlap on the wall screen. Her path is only a tiny stub near the ship line when you fire early, and the dashed green 'climb home' line is hard to pick out.
